segments.oily: One reviewer with slightly oilier skin reported visible improvement and avoided her usual breakouts even while camping.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report mixed results: some describe burning, rough texture, or drying out with regular use, while others alternate with the beginner formula specifically to avoid over-drying, and one reports no dryness issues at all.
segments.sensitive: The large majority of self-described sensitive-skin reviewers, including those with eczema or chronic illness, report no irritation and smoother, calmer skin, though a minority describe burning, red patches, or a slow multi-week acclimation period.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s, 50s, and one 74-year-old report firmer, plumper skin and softened fine lines, with one saying she saw no change despite consistent use.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers report firmer, plumper skin and reduced appearance of fine lines or a deep forehead line after several weeks of consistent use; one reviewer says she has seen no change in fine lines despite consistent use.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers pair the product with a moisturizer or ceramide serum and report no dryness or improved hydration; a few others report the product dried out their skin or caused rough texture, especially when used without pairing products.
concerns.redness: Some reviewers describe brief initial redness or faint red patches during the adjustment period that resolved with reduced frequency; most who mention redness say it faded and did not recur once tolerance built.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with compromised or reactive skin, including eczema, describe no irritation and calmer skin; one reviewer experienced severe burning and irritation before scaling back frequency.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report faded acne scarring and lightened dark spots with continued use; one reviewer says she has not yet seen improvement in redder or larger spots after about four weeks.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report fewer breakouts and calmer skin, including with acne-prone or hormonal acne when paired with treatments like salicylic acid; one reviewer with dry skin and hormonal acne reports it did nothing for her.

extraits.texte: I was looking to switch up the retinol in my skincare and this one did absolutely ✨nothing✨ for me. Cera Ve resurfacing retinol i will never betray you again. (I have dry skin with hormonal acne)
I gave this a try. I use retinol on a daily basis but this dried me out completely and made my skin look worse. I tried using it only every 3 days and moisturized the same as normal.

This product did not end up working for me, which is completely my fault. I tend to be sensitive to retinols but recently have been tolerating a 3% retinol serum just fine, so I reached for this advanced 5% as a step up. I used it for about three weeks, at first I had severe burning and irritation. Then, I worked my way up to every other day with limited irritation, but I still had very faint, pesky, red patches. Upon looking into this product further I discovered it contains Retinal, Hydroxypinacolone Retinoate and Lactic acid. Going from a regular retinol to a retinal, retinol and lactic acid was a bigger jump than I bargained for and looking back I should have opted for their beginner product at 2% as retinal being included makes it much stronger. I did however, notice the tightening effect starting and my skill cell turnover rate immediately speed up. Awesome over the counter strength and results in under 3 weeks, just too strong for me!!

My skin shouted 'HOORAY' from the first night I applied this. Something about this formula is a thousand times better than the beginner's retinol. I don't have any hydration problems with this at all! In fact, when I don't use it my skin is unhappier, and breaks out or flakes. Enough so that I almost never skipped, despite it taking nearly two months to fully acclimate. (I am stubborn about pain, and since all I experienced when I upgraded was very brief initial redness to go with my sensitized skin on face/neck, I just pushed through.) Is it the aloe in the gel? I'm not sure! But my skin looks dramatically better, finally usually entirely breakout-free, and my milia have been slowly going away too. Love this product!
This is my new holy grail of retinols! It is perfect for my 43 year old skin, it does not dry it out and it does not burn or sting. Which is super important for me!

extraits.texte: Love this product! I've been using it for a few weeks, and feel like my skin is making progress. For reference, I'm 26, use a retinoid for both acne and general maintenance, and have medically-sensitive skin. I had some temporary burning the first few times I used this, but it gets less with each use. This isn't unusual for me -- a lot of products do that occasionally. I switched to this from a similar-strength retinoid of another brand that I'd already worked up to using every night, so I've been using this every night from the start along with the oil-to-milk cleanser, ceramide serum, and polypeptide cream. My partner, who has less sensitive, slightly oilier skin has also been using it. She's also noticed a visible improvement in her skin, and even went camping without having the usual breakouts from the dust. She only has light burning when it's on an area that's been irritated by something else. She uses it in the evenings along with the AHA jelly cleanser and ceramide serum. Definitely a new favorite for us! This is an honest review in exchange for a free advance sample of the product.

I've tried other retinols and tretinoin, but I have extremely sensitive skin and always end up peeling and irritated. This retinol not only didn't irritate my skin, it worked well!! My dark spots lightened quickly and I feel like my skin texture improved overall.
